changelog:
Initial release of Agent Browser: a CLI tool for fast, Rust-based headless browser automation with Node.js fallback.

- Supports web navigation, interaction (click, type, fill, etc.), screenshot/PDF capture, and structured data extraction.
- Wide range of commands for snapshots, testing UI, controlling forms, recording video, cookies/storage management, and network interception.
- Semantic locators and ref-based element commands enhance accessibility and automation reliability.
- Tab, window, and frame management included.
- Full support for browser state save/load, device emulation, and session persistence.
